sections.heading: Holiday beauty gift set packaging with custom inserts
sections.text: Packaging applications Holiday beauty gift set packaging with custom inserts Christmas makeup gift box packaging should be sized around the complete seasonal assortment, not only the largest item. Lipstick tubes, pencils and glass bottles need different cavity shapes. Confirm the final product mix before approving the insert so a late SKU change does not leave an empty or unsuitable recess. Makeup gift set boxes Share each item with its cap fitted. Review how a shopper removes a narrow pencil or lipstick and whether printed names remain visible in the approved layout. Seasonal cosmetic packaging An evergreen outer box with a seasonal sleeve is an alternative to a fully Christmas-printed box. Compare both artwork scopes and confirm whether the same tray can serve future assortments. Plan a holiday packaging brief Work backwards from the required delivery date. Allow separately for artwork approval, a packed sample, production and freight, with timing confirmed in the quotation. Ask for the final carton dimensions before comparing shipping options. sections.heading: Build the presentation around your product
sections.text: Customization Build the presentation around your product Logo & foil Review foil, print, emboss or deboss artwork against the chosen paper. Custom colour Use ivory, black, seasonal colours or a Pantone-matched wrapped paper. Fitted insert Set cavity count, product orientation and clearance from measured samples. Surface finish Compare matte, soft-touch, textured and other finish options at sampling.

sections.heading: What changes the quotation?
sections.text: Quote factors What changes the quotation? Finished dimensions, board and wrap grade, insert material, print coverage, finishing steps, quantity, packed carton dimensions, destination and Incoterms all affect the final scope. Ask for the same assumptions on every supplier quotation.

sections.heading: Buyer questions
sections.text: FAQ Buyer questions What products can the insert hold? The insert can be laid out for lipstick, lip liner, nail polish, perfume, skincare or a mixed beauty collection after dimensions are provided. Can seasonal colours be changed? Yes. Burgundy, olive green and Pantone-matched wrapped papers can be reviewed with the artwork and finish plan. Can the gold foil be combined with other decoration? Foil can be combined with embossing, interior printing or selected surface finishes subject to a production review. When should a holiday project start? Share the launch date, destination and sample requirement early so sampling, approval, production and freight assumptions can be quoted together.
